Risk Description: Lack of segregation of duties (SoD) in a small team allows one person to initiate, approve and record a transaction, increasing risk of error or fraud.
Control Description: Owner/Director reviews and approves key transactions (sales above threshold, purchases above threshold, payments above threshold, journal entries) where full SoD is not practically possible.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Approval threshold matrix; sample approved transactions; org chart / role list
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Approval workflow log / ERP audit trail / JE listing

Risk Description: Absence of documented policies (credit policy, expense policy, procurement policy, HR policy) leads to inconsistent or arbitrary practices across the business.
Control Description: Key operating policies are documented, approved by owner/board and communicated to relevant staff; reviewed at least annually.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Policy documents with approval/sign-off; version history; staff acknowledgement

Risk Description: Management override of controls by promoter/owner-family without independent challenge, given concentrated ownership typical of MSMEs.
Control Description: Independent review of financials/MIS by an external CA/consultant or audit committee (if applicable) at defined intervals; whistleblower / grievance channel exists.
Data Points / Evidence Required: MIS review notes; minutes of review meetings; whistle-blower log if any

Risk Description: No budget or business plan exists, so deviations in revenue/cost are not identified timely.
Control Description: Annual budget prepared and approved; actual vs budget variance reviewed monthly/quarterly by management.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Approved budget; variance analysis reports

Risk Description: Sales invoices raised without a valid, approved sales order / customer PO, or without proof of delivery, risking fictitious or premature revenue recognition.
Control Description: Sales invoice is generated by the system/accountant only against an approved sales order and supported by delivery challan / e-way bill / dispatch proof.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Sales order register; delivery challans; e-way bills; sample invoices with supporting documents
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Sales Register + Delivery Challan/E-way Bill Register

Risk Description: Sales returns and credit notes are passed without proper authorization or supporting evidence, resulting in unwarranted reduction of revenue/receivables.
Control Description: Credit notes/sales returns above a defined threshold require approval from Sales Head/Owner and are supported by return documentation (GRN of return, customer confirmation).
Data Points / Evidence Required: Credit note register with approvals; return GRNs; customer correspondence

Risk Description: Overdue trade receivables are not monitored, increasing risk of bad debts and cash-flow strain typical to MSMEs with informal credit terms.
Control Description: Monthly customer-wise ageing analysis is prepared and reviewed; follow-up action documented for balances beyond agreed credit period; provisioning policy applied for doubtful debts.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Ageing report; follow-up/collection emails or calls log; provision workings

Risk Description: Sales are invoiced at prices/discounts outside the approved price list, resulting in revenue leakage or preferential treatment to select customers.
Control Description: Approved price list/discount matrix is maintained; invoices are reviewed against the price list before dispatch; deviations require approval.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Approved price list; sample invoices vs price list comparison; deviation approvals

Risk Description: GST is charged at an incorrect rate or with an incorrect place-of-supply determination on sales invoices, leading to short/excess tax collection and compliance exposure.
Control Description: GST rate/HSN master is maintained and periodically reconciled with the latest notifications; invoices reviewed for correct GSTIN, place of supply and tax rate before filing.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GST rate master; sample invoice review checklist; GSTR-1 vs sales register reconciliation

Risk Description: Purchases are made from unapproved or related vendors without competitive quotes, risking overpricing, favoritism or conflict of interest.
Control Description: Vendors are empanelled through a documented process (min. quotes/credentials for purchases above threshold); purchase orders raised only for empanelled vendors.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Vendor empanelment file; comparative quotation sheets; approved vendor master

Risk Description: Goods/services received are not matched against the purchase order and vendor invoice (no three-way match), leading to payment for short/incorrect supply or inflated quantities.
Control Description: Three-way match of Purchase Order, Goods Receipt Note (GRN) and vendor invoice is performed before booking/payment; discrepancies investigated and resolved.
Data Points / Evidence Required: PO register; GRNs; vendor invoices; three-way match working/checklist
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: PO Register + GRN Register + Purchase Invoice Register

Risk Description: Duplicate or double payments are made to vendors due to lack of a control marking invoices as 'paid'.
Control Description: Vendor invoices are stamped/marked 'PAID' with reference to payment voucher number upon payment; vendor ledger and statement of account reconciled periodically.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Paid invoice stamps; vendor reconciliation statements

Risk Description: TDS is not deducted, or deducted at an incorrect rate, on vendor payments/contracts (e.g. professional fees, contractors, rent), leading to disallowance under Income Tax Act and penal interest.
Control Description: A TDS-applicability checklist (section/rate/threshold) is verified at the time of booking each vendor invoice; TDS deducted is reconciled with 26AS/TRACES monthly.
Data Points / Evidence Required: TDS applicability checklist; TDS ledger; Form 26AS/TRACES reconciliation
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Purchase Register + TDS Ledger + Form 26AS export

Risk Description: Fictitious vendors are created, or genuine vendor master data (bank account/IFSC) is altered, enabling diversion of payments.
Control Description: Creation or change of vendor master data (especially bank details) requires dual approval and is independently verified (e.g. cancelled cheque/bank letter) before activation.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Vendor master change log; supporting KYC documents; approval trail
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Vendor Master change log + Employee Master

Risk Description: Physical stock does not match book stock due to pilferage, wastage, or recording errors, remaining undetected in the absence of periodic verification.
Control Description: Physical stock verification (full or cycle count) is performed periodically; variances are investigated, approved and adjusted in books with reasons documented.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Physical verification sheets; variance report with approvals; stock adjustment entries

Risk Description: Slow-moving, non-moving or obsolete inventory is not identified, resulting in overstated inventory value in financial statements.
Control Description: Inventory ageing analysis is prepared and reviewed periodically; provision for slow-moving/obsolete stock is made as per a documented policy.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Inventory ageing report; provisioning policy and workings

Risk Description: Inventory is not valued consistently (costing method - FIFO/weighted average - applied differently across periods or items), affecting comparability and accuracy of COGS.
Control Description: A documented inventory valuation policy is applied consistently across all items/periods and reviewed by the accountant/auditor.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Inventory valuation policy; sample costing workings

Risk Description: Goods move in/out of stores without proper documentation (gate pass, delivery challan), increasing risk of unrecorded sales/purchases or theft.
Control Description: All inward/outward stock movement is supported by a gate pass/challan, sequentially numbered and reconciled with the stock register.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Gate pass/challan register; reconciliation with stock ledger
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Gate Pass/Challan Register vs Stock Ledger

Risk Description: Ghost/fictitious employees exist on payroll, or unauthorized additions/changes are made, resulting in fraudulent payments.
Control Description: Payroll is processed only for employees present in the HR-approved employee master; new joiners/exits are updated only on receipt of approved HR documentation; headcount is reconciled monthly.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Employee master; joining/exit forms; monthly headcount reconciliation
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Employee Master + Payroll Register + Bank Payment File

Risk Description: Incorrect statutory deductions (PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS on salary) are made, leading to non-compliance, penalties or employee grievances.
Control Description: Payroll computation sheet (including statutory deductions) is reviewed and approved before disbursement each month; deduction rates reviewed on regulatory change.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Payroll register; statutory deduction working; approval sign-off

Risk Description: Overtime, incentives or reimbursements are paid without authorization from the reporting manager, inflating payroll costs.
Control Description: Overtime/incentive/reimbursement claims are approved by the reporting manager (with supporting documents for reimbursements) prior to inclusion in payroll.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Approved OT/incentive sheets; reimbursement claim forms with bills

Risk Description: PF/ESI/Labour Welfare Fund returns are filed late or with errors, exposing the MSME to interest, penalty and potential prosecution.
Control Description: A statutory compliance calendar tracks PF/ESI/LWF/PT due dates; returns are prepared, reviewed and filed within due dates by HR/consultant.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Compliance calendar/tracker; filed challans and returns with acknowledgements

Risk Description: Capital expenditure is incurred without budget approval or business justification, resulting in unplanned cash outflow or unproductive assets.
Control Description: All capex proposals are supported by justification/ROI and approved by owner/board against the approved capex budget before commitment of funds.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Capex approval notes; budget vs actual capex tracker

Risk Description: A fixed asset register (FAR) is not maintained or updated, leading to loss/misappropriation of assets going undetected and inaccurate depreciation.
Control Description: A fixed asset register with location, custodian and identification tag is maintained and physically verified periodically; discrepancies reconciled with books.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Fixed asset register; physical verification report; tagging photographs

Risk Description: Depreciation is not computed as per applicable rates/useful life (Companies Act / Income Tax), or asset disposals/write-offs are not authorized and recorded correctly.
Control Description: Depreciation policy (rates/useful life) is documented and applied consistently; disposals/write-offs require owner approval and are removed from FAR with gain/loss recorded.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Depreciation policy and workings; disposal approval notes

Risk Description: Weak controls over petty cash (no defined limit, no dual custody) increase risk of misappropriation.
Control Description: Cash payments are restricted to petty/incidental expenses within a defined limit, supported by vouchers, and cash is kept under dual custody/insured safe.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Petty cash policy; cash vouchers; cash count/surprise verification records

Risk Description: Bank reconciliation statements (BRS) are not prepared/reviewed regularly, so errors, unauthorized transactions or fraud may go undetected.
Control Description: Bank reconciliation is prepared monthly for each bank account and independently reviewed by someone other than the preparer; long-outstanding items are investigated.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Monthly BRS with preparer/reviewer sign-off; ageing of reconciling items

Risk Description: Cheque/online payments are released without adherence to the defined signatory/authorization matrix, risking unauthorized or excess payments.
Control Description: A payment authorization matrix (single/dual signatory based on amount thresholds) is defined and enforced in the bank mandate and/or online banking user rights.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Bank mandate/board resolution; authorization matrix; online banking user rights list

Risk Description: Cash flow is not monitored/forecast, leading to liquidity shortfalls or idle funds not earning returns - a common MSME vulnerability.
Control Description: A rolling cash flow forecast (e.g. 4-13 weeks) is prepared and reviewed by management to plan fund requirements/surplus deployment.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Cash flow forecast working; management review notes
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Cash flow forecast workings (not transactional data)

Risk Description: GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual return) are filed late, incorrectly, or input tax credit is claimed on ineligible/unmatched invoices, resulting in interest, penalty or credit reversal.
Control Description: GST compliance calendar is maintained; GSTR-2B reconciliation with purchase register is performed before ITC claim; returns are reviewed before filing by accountant/consultant.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GST compliance tracker; GSTR-2B reconciliation working; filed return acknowledgements
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Purchase Register + Sales Register + GSTR-1/2B/3B exports

Risk Description: Advance tax is not estimated/paid correctly, or TDS/TCS returns are filed late, leading to interest under the Income Tax Act.
Control Description: Advance tax liability is estimated quarterly based on projected profits and paid within due dates; TDS/TCS return filing tracked on the compliance calendar.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Advance tax working; challans; TDS/TCS return filing proof (Form 26Q/24Q/27EQ)
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Advance tax workings + TDS/TCS returns + Form 26AS

Risk Description: Statutory licenses/registrations (Shop & Establishment, Factory License, Trade License, MSME/Udyam registration, Fire NOC, Pollution Control) are not renewed on time, risking penalties or closure.
Control Description: A master license register (issuing authority, validity, renewal due date, responsible person) is maintained and reviewed monthly to track upcoming renewals.
Data Points / Evidence Required: License register; renewed license copies; renewal application proofs

Risk Description: Annual filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, DPT-3) and event-based ROC filings are missed or delayed, attracting additional fees and director disqualification risk.
Control Description: A ROC/secretarial compliance tracker is maintained by the Company Secretary/consultant; board approves financials before filing; filings tracked against statutory due dates.
Data Points / Evidence Required: ROC compliance tracker; filed forms with SRN/challans; board resolutions

Risk Description: Unauthorized or excessive access to the accounting software/ERP allows data manipulation or unauthorized transactions.
Control Description: User access to the accounting system is provisioned based on role (least privilege), with segregation between transaction entry and approval rights; access reviewed periodically.
Data Points / Evidence Required: User access list with roles; access review sign-off; system access rights report
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: System User Access Export + Employee Master

Risk Description: Financial/business data is lost due to hardware failure, cyber-attack (ransomware) or human error in the absence of a backup process.
Control Description: Data is backed up on a defined schedule (e.g. daily incremental, weekly full) to a secure on-site/cloud location; restoration is tested periodically.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Backup logs; restoration test records; backup policy

Risk Description: Shared logins/weak password practices prevent accountability for actions performed in the system.
Control Description: Individual, non-shared user IDs are enforced with a password policy (complexity, periodic change) and automatic session lock-out.
Data Points / Evidence Required: System password policy settings; user ID list vs headcount
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: System User ID list vs Employee Headcount

Risk Description: Related party transactions (sales/purchases/services with promoter-owned entities) are not identified, disclosed or benchmarked to arm's length, risking regulatory and tax challenge.
Control Description: A related party register is maintained (identifying relationships); all RPTs are approved by owner/board with basis of pricing documented and disclosed in financial statements/tax audit.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Related party register; RPT approval notes; pricing/benchmarking basis
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Related Party Register + Vendor/Customer Master + GL

Risk Description: Unsecured loans/deposits taken from or given to directors/related parties do not comply with Section 269SS/269T of the Income Tax Act or Companies Act provisions (deemed dividend, deposit rules), risking disallowance/penalty.
Control Description: Loan agreements are documented for all related-party loans; mode of receipt/repayment (account payee cheque/bank transfer) and applicable Companies Act/Income Tax compliance is reviewed before the transaction.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Loan agreements; bank transfer proof; compliance checklist (269SS/269T, Sec 185/186)

Risk Description: Manual journal entries are posted without approval or supporting rationale, creating opportunity for error or manipulation of financial results.
Control Description: All manual journal entries above a defined threshold require independent review and approval before posting, with narration and supporting documents attached.
Data Points / Evidence Required: JV approval workflow/log; sample JVs with supporting documents

Risk Description: Financial statements are not reviewed before finalization, so errors, omissions or inconsistent accounting treatment go undetected.
Control Description: A month-end close checklist (accruals, provisions, reconciliations) is completed and management reviews the MIS/financials with variance analysis before sign-off.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Month-end close checklist; MIS pack; variance analysis and review notes

Risk Description: Key balance sheet accounts (bank, debtors, creditors, GST, TDS, loans) are not reconciled periodically, allowing errors to accumulate undetected.
Control Description: A schedule of key general ledger accounts requiring periodic reconciliation is maintained; reconciliations are prepared, reviewed and old outstanding items followed up.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Reconciliation schedule; account-wise reconciliation statements with sign-off

Risk Description: Key financial ratios/trends (GP margin, expense-to-revenue, debtor days) move outside the expected historical range without explanation, indicating possible misstatement.
Control Description: Trend and ratio analysis is performed each period-end comparing current results to prior periods/budget; significant deviations are investigated and explained.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Multi-period trial balance/financial statements; ratio/trend workbook; variance explanations

Risk Description: Fraudulent or erroneous journal entries are posted by unauthorized or non-routine users (e.g. IT admin, owner's assistant, non-finance staff) to manipulate financial results.
Control Description: JE posting rights in the accounting system are restricted to authorized finance users; a system audit-trail report of JEs by user is reviewed monthly for postings by non-routine users.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL/JE listing with User ID field; list of authorized finance users; user access rights report
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: GL/JE listing with User ID field

Risk Description: Round-sum or suspiciously precise journal entries are posted, which are statistically less common in genuine transactions and may indicate manual manipulation or estimation errors.
Control Description: A round-number/round-sum JE exception report is generated and reviewed monthly; flagged entries are investigated for business rationale.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL/JE listing; round-sum exception report and review notes

Risk Description: Journal entries are posted on weekends, holidays or outside normal business hours, potentially indicating unauthorized or manipulated postings.
Control Description: A weekend/holiday/after-hours JE report is generated and reviewed monthly by the finance head/internal audit function.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL/JE listing with posting date and timestamp; public holiday calendar

Risk Description: Journal entries lack adequate narration/description, hindering understanding of business rationale and enabling concealment of inappropriate entries.
Control Description: The system mandates a narration field for all manual JEs; entries with blank or generic narration are flagged and reviewed before/after posting.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL/JE listing with narration field; missing-narration exception report

Risk Description: Entries are posted just before period-end and reversed immediately in the following period (round-tripping), potentially to temporarily inflate revenue/assets/profit at a reporting date.
Control Description: A reversing-entry report (entries reversed within a short window of the next period) is generated and reviewed as part of the period-end close process.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL/JE listing spanning period-end and the following period; reversing-entry exception report

Risk Description: Journal entries reflect unusual account combinations (e.g. debit to revenue/credit to cash, or postings to dormant/suspense accounts) indicating errors or manipulation.
Control Description: A predefined list of 'unusual' account-pair combinations is maintained; a JE exception report is run against this list monthly and investigated.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL/JE listing; unusual account-combination rule list; exception report

Risk Description: Expense claims/reimbursements are inflated or duplicated (the same bill claimed more than once, or personal expenses claimed as business expenses).
Control Description: Expense claims are supported by original bills, approved by the reporting manager, and checked for duplicate bill numbers/amounts before reimbursement.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Expense claim register with approvals and bill images/scans

Risk Description: Recurring overhead expenses (rent, utilities, AMC, subscriptions) vary significantly month-to-month without explanation, potentially masking unrecorded liabilities, double-booking or errors.
Control Description: A month-on-month trend analysis of recurring overheads is performed and significant variances are investigated and documented.
Data Points / Evidence Required: GL expense ledger by month; recurring-contract register (rent/AMC agreements) for cross-check

Risk Description: Expenses are booked in the wrong accounting period (cut-off error), whether inadvertently or to manage reported profit.
Control Description: Expense cut-off testing is performed at period-end: bills/invoices dated close to period-end are reviewed to confirm allocation to the correct accounting period.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Purchase/expense register around period-end; goods/service receipt dates; cut-off working paper

Risk Description: Fictitious or inflated sales are routed through related parties or unusual/new customers to artificially inflate revenue or turnover (e.g. to meet bank/NBFC loan covenants or MSME/Udyam turnover classification).
Control Description: Top-customer concentration and related-party sales are analyzed each period; unusual spikes in sales to related or newly-added customers, particularly near period-end, are investigated.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Sales register; customer master with creation dates; related party register
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Sales Register + Customer Master + Related Party Register

Risk Description: Customer master data (credit limit, address, bank details for refunds) is altered without authorization, enabling fraudulent transactions or diversion of refunds.
Control Description: Customer master changes require approval and are logged in the system; the customer master change log is reviewed periodically.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Customer master change log; approval evidence for credit limit changes

Risk Description: Purchase orders are deliberately split into smaller amounts to keep each PO below the approval/quotation threshold (structuring), circumventing the intended control.
Control Description: Multiple POs raised to the same vendor within a short window are reviewed for combined value against the approval threshold; splitting patterns are investigated.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Purchase order register; approval threshold policy; split-PO exception report

Risk Description: Expenses/purchases are booked and paid without a corresponding Goods Receipt Note (GRN) or proof of service delivery, risking payment for goods/services never received.
Control Description: All purchase invoices booked are matched to a GRN or service-completion certificate before payment approval; an exception report of invoices without GRN is reviewed.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Purchase invoice register; GRN/service completion register; no-GRN exception report

Risk Description: Negative or illogical stock quantities appear in the system, indicating unrecorded sales/purchases, data entry errors, or theft going undetected between physical counts.
Control Description: A negative-stock exception report is generated and reviewed after each stock update/posting cycle; root causes are investigated and corrected.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Stock ledger with running balances; negative-stock exception report

Risk Description: Two or more employees share the same bank account number, a strong indicator of a ghost employee or diversion of salary payments.
Control Description: A duplicate-bank-account test is run on the employee master/payroll bank file before each pay run; exceptions are investigated and resolved before disbursement.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Employee master; payroll bank transfer file; duplicate-account exception report
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Employee Master + Payroll Bank Transfer File

Risk Description: Contract/casual labour payments are made without adequate documentation (attendance/muster roll), enabling inflated headcount billing by labour contractors.
Control Description: Contractor labour bills are verified against muster roll/attendance records and evidence of PF/ESI compliance for contract labour before payment.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Muster roll/attendance records; contractor invoices; contract labour PF/ESI proof

Risk Description: Duplicate or missing asset tags/serial numbers result in the same physical asset being recorded twice (overstatement) or an asset going untracked in the register.
Control Description: An asset-tag/serial-number uniqueness check is performed on the fixed asset register periodically as part of the FAR maintenance process.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Fixed asset register; duplicate-tag exception report

Risk Description: Cash transactions are deliberately structured just below regulatory reporting/disallowance thresholds (e.g. Section 40A(3), Section 269ST, Section 269SS/269T) to circumvent tax compliance.
Control Description: A cash-transaction threshold and 'near-threshold' (structuring) exception report is generated and reviewed monthly by the finance head.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Cash book/payment register; structuring exception report; applicable threshold reference table

Risk Description: Where e-invoicing applies (based on turnover threshold) or e-way bill rules apply, invoices are raised without a valid IRN/e-way bill, risking penalty, ITC denial to customers and goods detention.
Control Description: E-invoice/e-way bill applicability is reassessed each financial year against the turnover threshold; an exception report flags qualifying invoices without a corresponding IRN/e-way bill.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Sales register; e-invoice/IRN log; e-way bill register; turnover threshold assessment working
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Sales Register + E-invoice/IRN Log + E-way Bill Register

Risk Description: Segregation-of-duties conflicts exist within system user roles (e.g. the same user can create a vendor and also approve payment to that vendor), enabling fraud.
Control Description: A segregation-of-duties conflict matrix is defined for the accounting system's roles/modules; a system user-role report is periodically analyzed against the matrix and conflicts remediated.
Data Points / Evidence Required: System user-role/rights export; SoD conflict matrix; conflict exception report

Risk Description: Vendors/customers are shared between the MSME and other promoter-owned entities without transparent disclosure, enabling undisclosed related-party dealings or profit-shifting.
Control Description: The vendor/customer master is cross-checked against the related-party register and known promoter-entity details (PAN/address/bank account) for undisclosed relationships, at least annually.
Data Points / Evidence Required: Vendor/customer master; related party register; promoter/director/associate entity details
Primary Data Source(s) for Analytics: Vendor/Customer Master + Related Party Register + Director Master
